title: Barbershop Management System
description: Built a web application for Customer, Barber and Administrator roles, supporting appointment booking, rescheduling, cancellation and confirmation.
detail: Developed backend services and REST API endpoints with MySQL persistence. Tested API behaviour using Postman.
challenge: Coordinating appointments across three different user roles while keeping booking changes consistent.
approach: Built role-specific flows for Customer, Barber and Administrator.
Implemented booking, rescheduling, cancellation and confirmation.
Developed REST endpoints and MySQL persistence; tested API behaviour with Postman.
takeaway: A practical foundation in role-based application design, API behaviour and relational persistence.

title: Adult Income Machine-Learning Project
description: Prepared an income-classification workflow and compared logistic regression, decision tree and random forest models.
detail: Explored hyperparameter tuning and evaluated accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and ROC-AUC. Examined performance across sex and race groups to assess fairness and communicate limitations.
challenge: Comparing predictive performance while making model limitations and demographic differences visible.
approach: Prepared the Adult Income dataset for classification.
Compared logistic regression, decision tree and random forest models, with hyperparameter tuning.
Evaluated accuracy, precision, recall, F1 and ROC-AUC, plus performance across sex and race groups.
takeaway: Model quality needs more than a single accuracy score; evaluation should communicate trade-offs and limitations.

title: AWS Serverless & Application Deployment
description: Created and invoked Python Lambda functions, validated inputs and used execution logs to troubleshoot behaviour.
detail: Configured an S3 event trigger with an incoming-file prefix and tested matching and non-matching object paths. Deployed a Django application to Elastic Beanstalk and worked with EC2, Linux command-line tools and Python virtual environments.
challenge: Understanding how application configuration, event rules and logs affect a cloud deployment.
approach: Created Python Lambda functions and validated valid and invalid inputs.
Configured S3 notifications with an incoming-file prefix and tested matching and non-matching paths.
Deployed a Django application using Elastic Beanstalk and worked with EC2, Linux and virtual environments.
architecture: S3 event → Python Lambda → execution logs
takeaway: Practical experience with deployment configuration, event-driven behaviour and log-based troubleshooting.

title: Container & Kubernetes Performance Labs
description: Containerised a C benchmark and compared CPU and memory performance under different resource constraints.
detail: Deployed replicated Nginx workloads to a local Kubernetes cluster and observed automatic Pod replacement after deleting a Pod. Configured CPU and memory requests and limits, then inspected logs and deployment details to analyse resource behaviour.
challenge: Separating workload behaviour from resource constraints in a local container environment.
approach: Containerised a C benchmark and compared CPU and memory behaviour under constraints.
Deployed replicated Nginx workloads and observed Pod replacement after deletion.
Configured CPU and memory requests and limits, then inspected logs and deployment details.
takeaway: Resource limits change workload performance; replica controllers help maintain the requested application state.

title: Parallel Computing & Scaling Benchmarks
description: Built and ran parallel benchmarks to measure execution time, speedup and efficiency across worker counts.
detail: Compared compute and memory workloads under strong and weak scaling to analyse hardware and resource bottlenecks. Practised MPI ring messaging, ping-pong, distributed mean calculation and broadcast.
challenge: Understanding why adding workers does not always give proportional speedup.
approach: Measured time, speedup and efficiency across worker counts.
Compared compute and memory workloads under strong and weak scaling.
Practised MPI ring messaging, ping-pong, distributed mean and broadcast.
takeaway: Parallel performance depends on communication, memory behaviour and available hardware, as well as worker count.

title: Graduate Job Application Tracker
description: Developing a Django web application to organise graduate job applications for the GreenOps and Sustainability CA.
detail: Configured and ran the application locally, resolved development issues and passed Django system checks. Planned next stages: cloud deployment, CI/CD, automated testing, security checks and resource-efficiency evaluation. These stages are planned work.
challenge: Organising graduate job applications while developing the application through a sustainability-focused CA.
approach: Configured and ran the Django application locally.
Resolved development issues and passed Django system checks.
Next steps: cloud deployment, CI/CD, automated testing, security checks and resource-efficiency evaluation.
takeaway: In progress: the local application is running. Deployment, CI/CD and efficiency evaluation are planned stages, not completed features.
